sources: Grand Vision, skill 3 (Infliction: Long Time Wish): rmxlinux Json/SkillData sk_wpn_sword_0021 (game 1.6); values SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_sword_0021 (level 1 → 9: phy_spell_up 30 → 84, phy_dmg_up 0.36 → 1.008; duration 20 at every level). Skill 1 (Agility), skill 2 (ATK) and skill 3's cardAttributeModifier (Arts Intensity + phy_spell_up, attribute 87 formulaItem 5) are on the stat panel. Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0029_pograni.md W2, W4, W5. wpn_sword_0021_ink is the same WeaponBasicTable row but for its ID and model (a skin): the loader gives it this kit (D3).

passiveEventActions: abilityEvent 206 (the wielder applies a buff) with CheckBuffIdInContext [buff_common_originum_frozen] (checkType 0: the ID list; its query's tags 528446605 and 1066759270 are read only under checkType 1, per the reading of Glorious Memory's twin check; batch-4 T1's open reading, in-game test 92) → buff_wpn_sword_0021_exist; or CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1, tag 1535684437 (Solidification) → the same. _exist: `duration` 20 s, stackingType 9 ("Effects of the same name cannot stack": one, refreshed). abilityEvent 30 + CheckSkillType [2, 7] (a battle skill or ultimate cast) with _exist → CreateBuffAttachingSkill buff_wpn_sword_0021_valid (attribute 50 formulaItem 5 + phy_dmg_up, for the cast); its end finishes _exist. Description: "When the wielder applies Originium Crystals or Solidification, during the next battle skill or ultimate cast within {duration}s, the wielder gains Physical DMG Dealt +{phy_dmg_up}."

_valid is attached to the cast, so the loader makes the consumed buff act on every hit of the wielder while that cast runs (consumedScope whileCasting, B5): fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-7e19489ae503.json t=33734 has _valid 0.648 (L5) on the Endministrator's battle skill hit, its Crush hit (buff_physical_crushed, 413,543) and the crystal hit (buff_common_originum_frozen); not on her ultimate at 35661 (consumed). The Endministrator's signature: only her kit applies Originium Crystals; the Solidification half works for any wielder whose hit forms it.

toggleBuffs buff_wpn_lance_0003 (Pathfinder's Beacon's ATK + atk_up, a key this skill doesn't have, under CheckCurHpRatio ≥ hp_ratio, another missing key) isn't applied: in-game test 75's variant (a missing key read as 0 would make it +0).
